lines: Argha-vessel before as having made from own dear mantra; by that altar flowers etc all wise should sprinkle.
l4.sanskrit_cite: arghapātraṃ purā yadvadvidhāya sveṣṭamantrataḥ tena sthaṇḍilapuṣpādi sarvaṃ saṃprokṣayedbudhaḥ
